correctness.rationale: A triangle is allowed precisely when every positive cyclic gap is strictly less than n/2; with four vertices some arc joining a triple has length at most n/2, so C3=0. Balanced gaps g_i and disjoint adjacent pairs give eight signed transversal triangles, boundary zero and coefficient +/-1, hence a primitive H2 class. All excluded orders 3,4,5,6,7,8,10 have an exhaustive triangle-gap classification and edge-by-edge collapses; the standalone finite verification checks the definitions and certificates through n=40 and the positive construction through n=100.

value.rationale: The integral H2-onset is a natural exact structural question for a geodesic admissibility complex. It exhibits a sharp parity-dependent threshold and a canonical primitive sphere mechanism for infinitely many cycle lengths, with a complete vanishing argument below each threshold. The claim is more informative than counting maximal sets and is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
